title.target: jìde mén wǎng nǎ kāi de rén

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ yìzhī rè bǐng sāi gěi tǎ wéi , cái wèn tā hé kànguò dé zěnyàng .
pairs.english: Nerai handed Tavi a hot flatbread before asking how review had gone.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把一只热饼塞给塔维，才问他核看过得怎样。

pairs.target: běi gōngfáng ménwài bǎi zhe liǎngkuāng xiū guò de gōngjù , yǒurén shēnshǒu lái ná , tā biàn yòng shǒubèi qīngqīng dǎngzhù , shuō nà yìkuāng yǐjīng shù guò , bié kàn shuí de bǐng liàng jiù xiāntiāo .
pairs.english: Two baskets of repaired tools stood outside the north workshop. When someone reached in, she gently blocked them: that basket was counted, no picking whichever handle shone brightest.
pairs.hanzi: 北工房门外摆着两筐修过的工具，有人伸手来拿，她便用手背轻轻挡住，说那一筐已经数过，别看谁的柄亮就先挑。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài pángbiān , chī dé tàng zuǐ , xiān diǎntóu , yòu yáotóu , nài lěi kàn tā yìyǎn , xiào dào nà kànlái búshì yíjù huà néng jiǎngwán , jìnqù zuò .
pairs.english: Tavi burned his mouth eating, nodded then shook his head. Nerai smiled: clearly more than a one-sentence story, come sit inside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在旁边，吃得烫嘴，先点头，又摇头，奈蕾看他一眼，笑道那看来不是一句话能讲完，进去坐。

pairs.target: wūlǐ kàochuāng zuò zhe gè tóufa huābái de nánrén , zhèngzài gěi yìbǎ páozǐ huàn xiē .
pairs.english: A graying man sat by the window, replacing a plane's wedge.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里靠窗坐着个头发花白的男人，正在给一把刨子换楔。

pairs.target: kòu shīfu , tā tīng nài lěi jièshào , biàn bǎ bǐng huàn dào lìngyìshǒu , xiǎng téng shǒu wènhǎo , nánrén què jiào tā xiān chī , bié bǎ yóu mǒ dào zìjǐ de mùtou shàng .
pairs.english: Master Kou, Nerai introduced. Tavi switched the bread to greet him, but the man said to eat first, not smear grease on his wood.
pairs.hanzi: 寇师傅，他听奈蕾介绍，便把饼换到另一手，想腾手问好，男人却叫他先吃，别把油抹到自己的木头上。

pairs.target: kòu shīfu yǐjīng bù gēn dà jiàzi pǎo huó , réng jiē gōngjù sòngxiū .
pairs.english: Master Kou no longer traveled to large structures, but still took tool repairs.
pairs.hanzi: 寇师傅已经不跟大架子跑活，仍接工具送修。

pairs.target: chuāng biān de bùbāo lǐ guǒ zhe yìpái xiǎo xiē , chángduǎnbùyī , tǎ wéi yǐwéi dōu néng suíbiàn tiāo , jiàn tā shì guò liǎnggēn , yòu jiāng yuánlái nàgēn ná qǐlái , cái zhīdào yǎnjīng kànzhe chàbùduō , sāijìnqù biàn búshì nàmehuíshì .
pairs.english: A cloth bundle held wedges of different lengths. Tavi thought any would do, until Kou tried two and picked the original up again: looking alike was not fitting alike.
pairs.hanzi: 窗边的布包里裹着一排小楔，长短不一，塔维以为都能随便挑，见他试过两根，又将原来那根拿起来，才知道眼睛看着差不多，塞进去便不是那么回事。

pairs.target: nài lěi tì tā bǎ tú tǒng yí dào zhuōshàng , shuō jiùshì xìn lǐ nà zhāng jiù tú . kòu shīfu méi diǎntóu zhuāngzuò jiàn guò , xiān wèn shìbushì yuán zhǐ .
pairs.english: Nerai moved his tube onto the table: the old plan from the letter. Kou did not pretend recognition, first asking whether it was original.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾替他把图筒移到桌上，说就是信里那张旧图。寇师傅没点头装作见过，先问是不是原纸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō shì shā dēng chāojiàn , quē jiǎo hé bǔ chāo nián yuè dōu zài hòumiàn , lìng yǒu yìzhāng dài hé , bùtóng yìhuí de .
pairs.english: Tavi said it was the Sandlamp copy, missing corner and copying date on the reverse, with a separate unverified sheet from another occasion.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说是砂灯抄件，缺角和补抄年月都在后面，另有一张待核，不同一回的。

pairs.target: nánrén jiāng zhǐ fānguò láikàn le zì , zài zhuǎn huílái , zhǐzhe yìpái biānhào : " zhè yíliè , nǐmen yǐwéi shì jiàn hào ? "
pairs.english: The man read the reverse, turned it back and pointed at a numbered row. “You think this column is part numbers?”
pairs.hanzi: 男人将纸翻过来看了字，再转回来，指着一排编号：“这一列，你们以为是件号？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō níng qí hái zài duì . kòu shīfu yòng zhǐjiǎ zài pángbiān kōng chù qiāo le yíxià , shuō zìjǐ dāngnián xiū guò lìng yíchù jiē jià , nàbiān yě yòng zhèzhǒng páifǎ , yǒu yíliè jì de shì jǐjiā hé xiū de cìxù , bùquánshì tiě jiàn pái dào nǎ yīhào .
pairs.english: Tavi said Ningqi was still comparing. Tapping a blank beside it, Kou recalled another connecting frame he had repaired: one column listed the order of joint repairs by several households, not only iron-part numbers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说宁岐还在对。寇师傅用指甲在旁边空处敲了一下，说自己当年修过另一处接架，那边也用这种排法，有一列记的是几家合修的次序，不全是铁件排到哪一号。

pairs.target: yǎnqián zhè chù tā méi qùguò , yào ná jiù xiū bó duì , bié tīng tā yíjù huà jiù quán gǎi le .
pairs.english: He had not visited this site; they must check the old repair book, not change everything on his word.
pairs.hanzi: 眼前这处他没去过，要拿旧修簿对，别听他一句话就全改了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tāochū bǐ , zài zìjǐ de zhǐbiān jì .
pairs.english: Tavi took his pen and noted it on his own paper.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维掏出笔，在自己的纸边记。

pairs.target: kòu shīfu shuō zhēn yào zhǎo , xiān wèn bái jiē jiù zhuǎnyùn bó lǐ yǒuméiyǒu lián xiū hào , búshì zhǎo yígè jiào xī wā de dìfāng , jiù cháo xī zǒu .
pairs.english: Kou said to look for joint-repair numbers in White Steps' old transfer registers first, not simply head west looking for a place called West Hollow.
pairs.hanzi: 寇师傅说真要找，先问白阶旧转运簿里有没有联修号，不是找一个叫西洼的地方，就朝西走。

pairs.target: hào méi duì shàng , zǒu dào nǎér dōu néng tīngjiàn yìtiáo xiàng nàmehuíshì de lù .
pairs.english: Without matching numbers, anywhere could offer a convincing-sounding route.
pairs.hanzi: 号没对上，走到哪儿都能听见一条像那么回事的路。

pairs.target: " nà yǐqián wèishénme chāi ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Then why was it dismantled?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “那以前为什么拆？”塔维问。

pairs.target: kòu shīfu jiāng páozǐ fānguòlái , shìleshì rèn , shuō zìjǐ guǎn guò de nà yíchù , xiānshì huài yíduàn méi rén chūqián , hòulái shānyǔ chōngdiào xiàmiàn de biàn dào , jǐjiā hùxiāng děng , děngdào yǒuleqián , yùn mùliào yě dé lìng ràolù .
pairs.english: Kou tested the plane's blade. At his old site, nobody paid for a broken stretch, then mountain rain washed away the path below. Households waited on each other; by the time money arrived, timber needed another detour.
pairs.hanzi: 寇师傅将刨子翻过来，试了试刃，说自己管过的那一处，先是坏一段没人出钱，后来山雨冲掉下面的便道，几家互相等，等到有了钱，运木料也得另绕路。

pairs.target: kě zhé tóng zhè yíchù wèihé zuìhòu zhī jì chāi , dé wèn dāngshí liúxià huà de rén , tā bùnéng bǎ zìjǐ nà chù de gùshì bān guòqù tì tā bǔqí .
pairs.english: But why Zhetong's final entry recorded only removal needed the people who left that record; he could not fill its gap with his own story.
pairs.hanzi: 可折桐这一处为何最后只记拆，得问当时留下话的人，他不能把自己那处的故事搬过去替它补齐。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài pángbiān tīng zhe méi chāhuà , zhídào kòu shīfu bàoyuàn bái jiē shōu jiù bó de jiàzi tài gāo , měi huí dōu jiào tā zhège lǎorén pá dèngzǐ ,
pairs.english: Nerai listened without interrupting until Kou complained the White Steps archive shelves were so high they always made an old man climb a stool,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在旁边听着没插话，直到寇师傅抱怨白阶收旧簿的架子太高，每回都叫他这个老人爬凳子，

pairs.target: tā cái shuō shàng huí míngmíng shì tā xián biérénzhǎo cuò , zìjǐ bǎ dèngzǐ tuō lái de . nánrén dèng tā yìyǎn , dītóu yòu qù qiāo nàgēn xiē , méi jiē .
pairs.english: then she said last time he had distrusted others' searching and dragged the stool over himself. He glared and went back to tapping the wedge without answering.
pairs.hanzi: 她才说上回明明是他嫌别人找错，自己把凳子拖来的。男人瞪她一眼，低头又去敲那根楔，没接。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi chī wán bǐng , jiāng shǒu cājìng , bǎ hé kàn shí nà zhāng luàn zhǐ dìgěi nài lěi .
pairs.english: Tavi finished the bread, cleaned his hands, and handed Nerai the messy review sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维吃完饼，将手擦净，把核看时那张乱纸递给奈蕾。

pairs.target: tā kànguò , wèn wéi lǎoshī yuē de liànxí huì buhuì tóng hòumiàn gōngqī zhuàng . tā shuō ruǎn héng hái méi gěi xīn rìzi , zìjǐ xiǎng chèn zài bái jiē , duō liú yígè bànrì zǒu yíduànlù , bù zhǐshì qù kàn biérén de tú .
pairs.english: She asked if Vey's practice would clash with later work. Ruan Heng had no new date yet, he said; while at White Steps he wanted half a day to walk a route, not only see other people's maps.
pairs.hanzi: 她看过，问维老师约的练习会不会同后面工期撞。他说阮衡还没给新日子，自己想趁在白阶，多留一个半日走一段路，不只是去看别人的图。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā shuō dé bǐ zài xìn shàng shùn xiē , yě méi zài pà zìjǐ xiàngshì jí zhe tǎo yítàng wán .
pairs.english: He spoke more easily than in his letter, no longer afraid he sounded like begging an outing.
pairs.hanzi: 这回他说得比在信上顺些，也没再怕自己像是急着讨一趟玩。

pairs.target: nài lěi táitóu wèn , yào qù nǎér . tā xiǎngqǐ yuǎn pō de hóng wūdǐng , zhīdào yǎnxià qù bùliǎo , biàn shuō xiǎng xiān cóng xuégōng hòushān nàtiáo qùshí dēng chà de lù zǒu qǐ , zìjǐ jiàn guò tú , méiyǒu zǒu dào guò chàkǒu .
pairs.english: Nerai asked where. Remembering the distant red roofs were out of reach now, he suggested the academy's back-hill path to Stone Lamp Fork, a route he had seen mapped but never walked to the junction.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾抬头问，要去哪儿。他想起远坡的红屋顶，知道眼下去不了，便说想先从学宫后山那条去石灯岔的路走起，自己见过图，没有走到过岔口。

pairs.target: nài lěi xiǎng le xiǎng , shuō sānrì hòu de shàngwǔ yǒu bàntiānkōng , wǔfàn qián huílái , tā xiàwǔ lìng yǒu yuē .
pairs.english: Nerai considered, then offered the morning three days later, back before lunch; she had another afternoon appointment.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾想了想，说三日后的上午有半天空，午饭前回来，她下午另有约。

pairs.target: lù réng zài tōngxíng fànwéi lǐ , méi tì tā xǔ zǒu fēnglù ; dào chàkǒu yǐqián ràng tā dài , nǎlǐ yào tíng , wèishénme tíng , xiān tīng tā shuō .
pairs.english: The route stayed within open access, no promise of closed paths. He would lead to the fork, saying where to stop and why first.
pairs.hanzi: 路仍在通行范围里，没替他许走封路；到岔口以前让他带，哪里要停、为什么停，先听他说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu diǎn dé tài kuài , tā yòu tiān yíjù , búshì jiāng dìtú bèixiàlái gěi zìjǐ tīng . ruò zhǐshì bǐ shuí niàn dé shùn , zìjǐ jīnrì yǐjīng zài zhè liǎngkuāng gōngjù qián tīng gòu le .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded too fast. She added that this was not reciting a map; she had heard enough smooth recitation before those tool baskets today.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头点得太快，她又添一句，不是将地图背下来给自己听。若只是比谁念得顺，自己今日已经在这两筐工具前听够了。

pairs.target: kòu shīfu hūrán cóng bāo lǐ chōuchū yíkuài xiǎo mùpiàn , dìguòlái . tǎ wéi yí lèng , yǐwéi shì gěi zìjǐ de , nánrén què yuèguò tā dìgěi nài lěi , shuō shàng huí qiàn de xiāng gài diànpiàn bǔ hǎo , bié zài ná zìjǐ de jiù xiédǐ sāi .
pairs.english: Kou suddenly produced a small wooden piece. Tavi thought it was for him, but the man handed it past him to Nerai: the promised box-lid shim, so she could stop using old shoe soles.
pairs.hanzi: 寇师傅忽然从包里抽出一块小木片，递过来。塔维一愣，以为是给自己的，男人却越过他递给奈蕾，说上回欠的箱盖垫片补好，别再拿自己的旧鞋底塞。

pairs.target: nài lěi liǎnshàng nà diǎn lǐsuǒdāngrán zhōngyú pò le , jiào tā dāngzhe xuéshēng shǎoshuōliǎngjù .
pairs.english: Nerai's composed expression finally broke; she told him to say less in front of a student.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾脸上那点理所当然终于破了，叫他当着学生少说两句。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào dé chàdiǎn yòu qiàng zhù .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed until he nearly choked again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑得差点又呛住。

pairs.target: chūménshí , tā méi dàizǒu rènhé xiàng mìmì yíyàng bāo hǎo de jiù jiàn , zhǐyǒu liǎngtiáo gāi qù chá de jìfǎ , hé yíduàn yǐjīng yuēdìng yóu zìjǐ lǐngtóu de lù .
pairs.english: He left with no old component wrapped like a secret, only two leads to check and an agreed route he would lead himself.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，他没带走任何像秘密一样包好的旧件，只有两条该去查的记法，和一段已经约定由自己领头的路。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhǐtǒng bèi hǎo , fāxiàn nà liǎngkuāng gōngjù yǐ ràng rén tái zǒu yìkuāng , běi gōng fánglǐ zhàojiù yǒurén děng yìbǎ néng yòng de páozǐ .
pairs.english: Shouldering his tube, he saw one basket carried away. In the north workshop someone still waited for a working plane.
pairs.hanzi: 他将纸筒背好，发现那两筐工具已让人抬走一筐，北工房里照旧有人等一把能用的刨子。
